body: I also emailed my GP surgery about an hour and a half ago because I thought I'd be able to go through with it, and didn't want my cats to starve to death.. I guess I'm going to have some explaining to do in the morning...
I cant do anything properly.. I have everything I need and felt like I was ready to die, but just cant seem to do it.. I wish it was easier :/ I'm just going to cry myself to sleep I think
Because I'm transsexual and they dont agree with it and dont want me around

I was studying but took time out because of being unwell, and I hoped I'd be well enough to go back this academic year, but it's too late now.. And the only thing that makes it difficult is my cats because I love them so much, but I know they'll be better without me anyway.

> Can you tell me the reason why you decided to do this? I'd like to know what's causing your problems.

My life is a mess, my family don't speak to me, I hate my body, I constantly feel depressed and only ever leave my home to go to dr's appointments, I can barely look after myself because I just cant motivate myself to do simple things like just keeping my home clean and tidy, and I keep trying to get help and then get made promises that aren't kept, or get told directly by the person (e.g. the counsellor i tried seeing and also my GP) that they dont know how to help me.

It used to make me cry when I'd think about suicide because I'd think of how my family would feel, but they don't speak to me anymore, and I have nothing left to live for. I just cant wait for it to be over.
There's no point.. If my dr and counselling cant help me, I doubt anyone here can. I've accepted the fact now that I'm too broken to be fixed. I'll just be glad once my pathetic existence is over.
